name: Dioctyltin carboxylate
description: Dioctyltin carboxylate (CAS 24577-34-2 ) is an organotin compound used as a catalyst in polymer and elastomer processing. It promotes curing, crosslinking, and polymerization reactions across a range of industrial formulations where controlled tin-based catalysis is required. In PVC stabilization and polyurethane systems, it functions as a condensation catalyst, accelerating urethane bond formation in foam and elastomer production. Silicone sealant and RTV rubber manufacturers use it to drive room-temperature vulcanization. This catalyst is essential for controlling the cure rate and final mechanical properties of the material. Coating formulators incorporate it into moisture-cure systems where precise catalytic activity at low loading levels is commercially important. Adhesive and sealant producers working with tin-catalyzed crosslinking systems select it for applications requiring a balance between pot life and cure speed. It ensures consistent performance across various chemical environments and processing temperatures. Dioctyltin carboxylate is supplied as a liquid, typically at high active-tin concentrations suited for direct addition or dilution into formulations. This versatility makes it a preferred choice for large-scale industrial manufacturing. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with specifications aligned to industrial catalyst applications.
